note: Brief 023, the public door on the west face (Waymark, 2026-10-19): re-recorded on the tree (engine 0.8.1) after Sky's door option (b) and the service door on the east face (Vantage moved the points; Splice the site facings, SF-8, tests and verify). Inputs regenerated from their generators: out/people (bun run people), sim/data site, people, takedown and provisional (bun run sim:site), the rounds file (bun run rounds --out sim/data/handover.rounds.json) and civic-block.cover.json (bun run cover, Pulse's file: the forecourt moved its cover). No offset in mission.json moves. The summoned guard walks 79.8 m to Inez's side (57.0 s each way; was 63.7 m, 45.6 s), so the unguarded door runs 2:54.0 from the call (was 2:31.2); the escort from Service lane (62.5, -16.8) to the getaway bay is 64.6 m on the engine's grid (46.2 s; was 54.8 m). Scripts: every planned route recomposed; the door-side waits move with the door (route A and loud: (69.5, -42.5), 5.6 m south of it, out of the guard's west-facing cone; route G: (65.2, -41.1) on the landing beside the guard; G-kill carries the body round the Office's north end to the east-face service door); the loud family keeps the Scout and Fixer holstered until the final fight, because the response unit now walks past the getaway car to the west-face door (loud-fight loses its close on the café wall, loud-left-downed sends the Scout out once the unit is down, loud-fast converges on loud); careless-reporter-not-stopped takes guard 73 on his new walk at 4:06.5; the unplanned fail and careless scripts are retimed for the longer walks to the moved cabinet, the Office approach and the driver (fail-entry-seen-patrol: the sweep sees the west-face door from 4:34.5, the entry is at 4:40.4). Results against c021: route-a 4:36.4 (4:31.2), route-a-board 4:30.2 (4:25), route-a-pressure-board 3:41.8 (3:30.1), route-b-board 7:48.2 (7:40.6), 0:41 before the close (0:49), route-g-fast-board 3:47.8 (3:36.1), route-g-kill 5:19.6 (4:55.5; the longer carry to the east face), loud 4:34.6, 10 T (4:27.5, 14 T); Trail and Alert unchanged on every quiet route. Known, not recorded as a script: guard 74 walks the Office's east face from about 4:00 to the official entrance and passes the service door; a route A whose call comes 50-80 s later than recorded brings Vale out at 4:20-4:50, in his sight, and his report of the carry makes the win loud (Alert 2, 6 T); earlier or later it is clean.
